description: Captioned walkthrough assembled from actual browser screenshots of the normal run viewer, not a continuous screen recording.
policy: Deterministic scripted demo policies, not expert play or model reasoning.
presentation: Each source viewport is preserved at original size, with a separate 96-pixel caption strip appended below; no UI content is covered.
